assetInventory.method: Declared asset registries with real PNG/hash/dimension/alpha checks; shared sheets counted once. This does not certify source-frame fidelity.

evidenceRules.missing: An authored capability or dedicated animation/script is absent; a generic rendering fallback may still draw successfully.
evidenceRules.adaptation: An authored runtime sequence, generated bitmap, reused pose, transformed static layer or procedural effect. Its existence does not prove source fidelity.
evidenceRules.verified: Requires independently retained source reference, frame/scene comparison and explicit validation. No such certification is inferred from a name, profile, bitmap, or passing tests.
evidenceRules.bitmapEvidence: Binding analysis below inspects routing metadata only. Exact repeated RGBA cells are measured separately by auditCombatCharacterAnimations.mjs.

abilities.heuristicNote: The original broad Guard suffix includes 118 concrete defense names requiring review, not 118 confirmed generic actions.
abilities.strictDefinition: simple/secondary: original placeholder expressions; defense: Signature Guard|defensive action or exact hero.name + " Guard".

entries.sourceReference: Adult Solid Snake uses the SOCOM Mk23, Nikita and cardboard box. His unarmed punch/punch/kick combo is condensed into one contact impact. Advanced CQC of other protagonists/eras and damaging chaff are not added.

Cyborg Raiden uses a high-frequency blade, Ninja Run and physical parry. Zandatsu Overdrive is the project label for an adapted close blade sequence: no instant kill, life extraction or distant area strike is implied.

entries.sourceWork: Metal Gear Solid (1998) / Metal Gear Solid 2 (2001)
entries.sourceReference: Hal Emmerich provides Codec, technical analysis and later Philanthropy intelligence. Terminal commands provide allied information support only. Philanthropy Upload and Metal Gear Data Hack are project labels, not canonical damaging attacks; no beam, infection, enemy HP loss or healing is created.

entries.sourceWork: Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (1983)
entries.sourceReference: Adult Luke wears black and uses his green lightsaber. Force push is adapted as a bounded local force impulse. His close saber sequence is one timed impact, not a damaging Jedi mind beam or an invented telepathic attack.

Armored Darth Vader uses his red lightsaber and telekinetic Force choke. Choke is a bounded single-target damaging command without a forced instant kill or invented infection. The Imperial March is music, not an attack.

Han uses a DL-44 heavy blaster and practical cover. His personal super is one accurate blaster shot. The Kessel Run and Millennium Falcon are not a remote area power, and cover provides no magical carbonite barrier.

Final Heaven
Great Gospel
Catastrophe
Kamehameha
Final Flash
Wind Release: Rasenshuriken
Indra’s Arrow

Lion Heart is Squall's final Renzokuken finishing technique unlocked by the Lion Heart gunblade. The ultimate gunblade is an explicit equipment adaptation for this combat sequence; clothing follows the local FFVIII Squall reference.

Wishing Star is a Combine Limit Break performed together with Angelo. It is not Angel Wing. The partnered leap and star-like motion are a condensed combat adaptation, not a reproduction of the complete original cinematic. Angelo is represented as a brown-and-white medium collie-like dog, with no invented fantasy anatomy.

Quistis uses a whip and Shockwave Pulsar is her strongest Blue Magic, learned with Dark Matter. The gravitational energy buildup and shockwave are adapted to compact side-view frames, without turning them into Laser Eye or inventing a summon.

Seifer's original FFVIII identity uses his long light-gray/white coat with red cross motifs and the Hyperion gunblade. No Mercy is his Fire Cross Limit Break. The local black fur-collar jacket is a known reference mistake, explicitly corrected rather than copied.
Final Fantasy VIII (1999), Laguna Loire — Desperado Limit Break: thrown grenade and one-handed machine-gun fire while hanging from a rope.
Final Fantasy VIII (1999), Zell Dincht — My Final Heaven Duel finisher: a running wind-up and final gloved punch, compactly adapted with ground impact.

Final Fantasy VIII (1999), Selphie Tilmitt — The End, résultat de Slot qui termine le combat et élimine les ennemis : calme visuel d’une conclusion en prairie/fleurs, sans gore ; effet offensif et résultat conservés par le moteur.
Final Fantasy VIII (1999), Irvine Kinneas — Hyper Shot Shot Limit Break: powerful long-firearm shots with ballistic muzzle flashes.

Lightning's unique Army of One uses a rapid chain of gunblade attacks and gunfire. This is a compact side-view adaptation with the Blazefire Saber in its sword and gun configurations; it does not summon Odin or use Lightning Returns costumes.

Fang uses a segmented double-ended bladed lance. Highwind is her own unique plunging lance attack, not the Bahamut Eidolon or a dragon manifestation. Its leap, descent and landing are compact adaptations to the arena.

Vanille's unique Death is a Saboteur ability; the game's damage-area action is a gameplay adaptation of its original instant-death chance and damage behavior. The art is a casting motif without a victim, an execution, guaranteed death or Hecatoncheir.
Snow’s original Commando full-ATB skill Sovereign Fist: forward approach, upward leap and one descending physical fist impact with a ground shock; no gun or Shiva transformation.
Sazh’s original Ravager full-ATB skill Cold Blood: a long alternating dual-pistol gunfire volley building the target’s chain, adapted to four poses; no Eidolon or vehicle substitution.

Hope’s original Ravager full-ATB skill Last Resort: a volley of non-elemental magical blasts launched upward then raining down on targets, with the original adolescent and his Airwing boomerang retained; not Alexander.

Final Fantasy XV (2016), young Noctis in Crownsguard fatigues, Engine Blade and Armiger Royal Arms. Compact four-pose Armiger choreography is authored adaptation, not source-identical timing or weapon count.
Final Fantasy XV (2016), Gladiolus Amicitia — Dawnhammer is a greatsword overhead ground strike, compactly adapted. The old local unarmed/gun-slot defaults do not establish his equipment.

Final Fantasy XV (2016), sighted Ignis Scientia before Altissia — dual daggers, Regroup support and Overwhelm coordinated assault. These four-pose sequences represent his directing gestures and dagger portion, not a claim that he attacks with firearms or performs the entire team action alone.

Final Fantasy XV (2016), Prompto Argentum — handgun specialist, Piercer and Trigger Happy ballistic technique. Burst count and gun poses are compact authored adaptation; no firearm from another franchise or camera-as-weapon.

Final Fantasy XV (2016), Lunafreya Nox Fleuret as Oracle: cleansing and healing through prayer and blessing. Oracle’s Blessing is the project’s authored group-healing name, not a verified source attack name. This atlas preserves the local white-gown identity and represents support only.

Red XIII is a quadrupedal orange-red feline/canine creature with XIII shoulder tattoo, dark mane and a flame at his tail tip. Cosmo Memory is his fourth Limit Break; the compact astral sphere and pulse here are an adapted presentation, not a literal reproduction of the full source cinematic.

Original young Yuffie uses a large four-point shuriken and a green top/beige-shorts outfit. All Creation is her final offensive energy-beam Limit Break; it remains separate from the healing Clear Tranquil secondary.

Vincent's fourth Limit Break transforms him into Chaos. This32-pose atlas deliberately remains his human1997 form, showing preparation/recovery only. A separate actual Chaos body atlas replaces the human body during the runtime buff; no demon anatomy is faked on these human frames.

Naruto Part I Rasengan: a rotating blue chakra sphere formed in the palm, brought forward through a close-range rushing palm strike. Later-series Rasenshuriken, Six Paths and adult transformations are excluded.
Sasuke Part I Chidori: blue lightning gathered around one hand, followed by a forward close-range charge. No Rinnegan, Susanoo or later-series weapon outfit.

Sakura Part I Bunshin no Jutsu: Academy illusion clone technique, adapted as a self-support feint and composure buff. An intangible stationary duplicate appears, then dissolves; no medical healing, superhuman punch or physical clone attack.

Dragon Ball Z, Piccolo charges Makankosappo / Special Beam Cannon with index and middle fingertips at his forehead, then releases a narrow spiral-wrapped ki beam from those two extended fingers. Purple gi corrects the near-black local reference palette. Compact effects and timings are authored adaptation, not official frames.

Naruto Shippuden, war-era Kakashi uses his single left Mangekyo Sharingan for Kamui space-time distortion. This is the pre-double-Mangekyo version, without Susanoo. The atlas depicts eye concentration and a compact grey space warp, not the electrical hand attack Raikiri. Gameplay area, timings and visual glyphs remain authored adaptation.
Halo 3 — John-117 in green Mark VI MJOLNIR; M6/R Spartan Laser is a shoulder-fired charged directed-energy weapon, not the MA5C assault rifle.
Halo 2 — Thel Vadam in Arbiter ceremonial armor, Sangheili anatomy and a twin-pronged plasma energy sword; the action is a forward sword lunge.
Halo 3 — Sergeant Major Avery Johnson, Marine battle-rifle leadership and M6/R Spartan Laser at Installation 08; a human soldier, no magical powers.
DOOM Eternal — the modern Doom Slayer wears green Praetor armor and uses the modern BFG-9000, launching a green energy projectile; not the 1993 Doom Marine.
DOOM (1993) — classic Doom Marine: gray helmet, green vest and bare muscular arms; original BFG-9000 launches a green ball. No Eternal armor, Flame Belch or dash is added.

Vanishing Rasengan: young Boruto forms and throws a compact Rasengan that fades from sight in flight; the ordinary black-and-pink jacket continuity is retained. No Karma, Jougan showcase or Two Blue Vortex abilities.
Sarada's young red-glasses continuity with Sharingan-assisted Chidori, blue lightning gathered in one hand and brought forward in a close-range charge. No adult costume, Mangekyo ability or Susanoo.
Lightning Release: Snake Lightning, electric chakra shaped as slender undulating serpents from Mitsuki's hands. Pre-timeskip blue-and-white robe; no Sage transformation or Goku-like energy beam.
Strive continuity: Sol's Outrage Mk.II and red/black jacket with dark trousers. Tyrant Rave is an advancing close-range flaming fist Overdrive; no Dragon Install or unrelated full-arena ray.

Strive continuity: short blond-haired Ky, white-and-blue open jacket, dark trousers and Strive Thunderseal. Ride the Lightning carries Ky's sword-first body dash in blue electricity; no Xrd ponytail or Dragon Install.

The effective Suture du Voile damages enemies in an area while Patch de Trame heals allies; no resurrected dead or soul soldiers.

src/game/characterPlaques.js#arca_bastion: Verrou de Convergence seals a deceptive passage; public/sprites/generated/heroes/nexus-de-convergence/arca-bastion-complete/manifest.json#loreAnchors: Atrium rifle, hexagonal orange anchor shield and Convergence Lock. Effective project special is offensive enemy beam/line, distinct from defensive Rempart and Balise; no dead become soldiers.
Sonic Adventure — Sonic with Ancient Light / Light Speed Attack, normal blue Adventure form, no Super Sonic or Shadow powers.
Sonic Adventure2 — Tails pilots the Cyclone in walker mode. VulcanCannon, Lock-OnMissile and PowerLaser are machine actions; no handheld laser or Tornado-plane substitution.
Sonic Adventure2 / Battle — Knuckles fights with fists and Drill Claw; Thunder Arrow calls thin lightning above the opponent. Hammer Gloves are the project’s explicitly selected upgrade.

Physical dual-pistol sequence: raises both real Beretta pistols from low-ready, aims toward screen right, a small LOCAL amber muzzle flash at the barrel exit in THIRD cell only with shifted arms/recoil, lowers both pistols to recover in FOURTH cell. No laser beam, distant bullet, target impact or magic kiss. Keep both pistols separate and anatomically held. entries.sourceReference: Bastion’s beacon defines a safe route: deployment, alignment and protective planes, never an explosion.

entries.key: Nexus de Convergence::Drone de Suture::Drone de Suture
entries.sourceReference: Loom’s drone maintains an ally’s signature: hover, medical link, stabilization and return to the caller.

entries.key: Nexus de Convergence::Reflet Non Remplace::Reflet Non Remplace
entries.sourceReference: Tessera manifests a possible reflection without replacing a person: a mirrored arrival and refracted proof, then dissolution.

entries.key: Nexus de Convergence::Sonde de Retour::Sonde de Retour
entries.sourceReference: Nadir’s probe verifies a route in both directions: outbound scan, measured contact and a visible retraced return.
Halo Pelican gunship support: heavy approach, undercarriage firing pass and continued flight out of the arena.
Dog’s physical assistance uses a robot leap and grounded force, followed by a bounding retreat; no energy detonation.
Portal sentry: vertical placement, visible red targeting line, a ballistic burst and folding withdrawal.
PAYDAY’s deployable sentry is placed on the floor, aims mechanically and fires bullets; it does not walk or cast a beam.
The existing page deployment is represented by placed pages, paper motion and camera-static interference, without a fire or magic blast.
BFG-9000: capacitor charge, one traveling plasma sphere and branching green energy arcs; a single gameplay impact remains authoritative.
May’s Great Yamada Attack brings the whale across the scene in an arcing passage with a water surge, then carries it out.
Final Fantasy VII Hellfire: Ifrit arrives, gathers fire and sends a ground-reaching flame wave into the opposing formation.
Final Fantasy VII Diamond Dust: Shiva gathers cold, encases targets in ice and shatters the ice before disappearing.
Final Fantasy VII Megaflare: Bahamut descends above the battlefield, charges at its mouth and releases the charged ray into the targets.

entries.key: Sonic::Tails et le Tornado::Tornado Machine Gun
entries.sourceReference: Sonic Adventure’s Tornado: a banked airplane approach, machine-gun pass and rising departure, without a teleporting ground entrance.
Star Platinum manifests by Jotaro, closes to punch range, performs a visible fist barrage and withdraws to the caller.

entries.key: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure::Hermit Purple::Hermit Purple — Hamon
entries.sourceReference: Hermit Purple grows from Joseph as thorny purple vines; a gold Hamon pulse travels along the vine and retracts with it.
Gold Experience manifests beside Giorno, advances to its selected target, punches in a compact barrage and returns.
Imani’s project-owned Ghostline uprising spreads coordinated drone/signal links; its technology is not a ghost-shaped magical explosion.

entries.key: The Aether Crown::Mutinerie des Cieux::Mutinerie des Cieux
entries.sourceReference: Elara’s project-owned corsair command brings airborne allied craft along an advancing sky route with coordinated deck fire.
Bram Quill’s autonomous valve drone hovers, builds pressure and vents directed steam, then returns without exploding.

entries.key: Meridian Clockwork::Faucon à Ressort::Faucon à Ressort
entries.sourceReference: Lio’s spring-driven mechanical falcon winds up, dives along a clockwork arc and visibly homes back toward its operator.

entries.key: Aegea: War of the Moirai::Forge des Cent Boucliers::Forge des Cent Boucliers
entries.sourceReference: Doros’s project-owned forge constructs a bronze shield formation: assembling plates, a closing line and orderly withdrawal.

entries.key: Tawantinsuyu: The Split Sun::Message des Quatre Quartiers::Message des Quatre Quartiers
entries.sourceReference: Killa Mayu’s four-quarter message is a courier relay with linked route points and traveling signals, not an explosive summoned army.

entries.key: Yomi no Kage::Parade Nocturne Réconciliée::Parade Nocturne Réconciliée
entries.sourceReference: Daichi’s reconciled tsukumogami take a ground procession route with lantern-like markers before passing out of the scene.

entries.key: Mandate of Nine Heavens::Pas de l’Ancêtre::Pas de l’Ancêtre
entries.sourceReference: Mei Zhen’s ancestor conveys a message without becoming a soldier: gentle manifestation, guiding threads and a dissolving return.

entries.key: Ilyr Concordat::Chœur Nym Non Unanime::Chœur Nym Non Unanime
entries.sourceReference: Ixo-9’s distributed Nym collective coordinates distinct node voices through linked signal waves, not an indiscriminate explosion.
Parasoul’s Inferno Brigade calls physical Black Egret support: a ground convoy, coordinated ballistic fire and departure.
